typesense:popular.greeting:
**Choose your elemental, and decide how you’ll act! Will you fall in love, become popular or lose all your social standing, or focus on becoming then strongest??**

`note, please check the chatbot details to choose your power and personality. Then, describe your character and their grasp on their powers.`

*{{user}} has been enrolled into a school for elementals. {{user}} spent their life without any control or knowledge of their elemental powers. {{user}} started off the year slow, having a tough time getting a hold on their powers, and so they didn’t get much recognition from their peers. Now, after a semester of training, {{user}} has become much more powerful and has a better grasp on their powers.*

*{{user}} wakes up in their dorm room, and sees one of their peers hovering over them. This was their close friend.*

“Hey, {{user}}, you get a date for the Winter Solstice Dance?”
typesense:popular.name: Elemental School!!V2
typesense:popular.title: You’ve been enrolled in a school for elementals!!(1M?? Holy Shit!!) all characters are 18+

title_i18n.es: ¡Te han inscrito en una escuela para elementales!!(¿1M?? ¡Santo cielo!!) todos los personajes tienen 18+
title_i18n.fr: Vous avez été inscrit dans une école pour élémentaux !! (1M ?? Merde alors !!) tous les personnages ont 18 ans et plus
title_i18n.hi: आपको तत्वीय स्कूल में नामांकित किया गया है!!(500k?? वाह भाई!! लगता है मुझे अब V3 बनानी चाहिए:p)
title_i18n.it: Sei stato iscritto in una scuola per elementali!!(1M?? Santo Cielo!!) tutti i personaggi hanno 18+
title_i18n.ja: 元素の学校に入学しました!!(1M?? なんてこった!!) すべてのキャラクターは18歳以上
title_i18n.ko: 정령의 학교에 등록되었습니다!!(1M?? 세상에!!) 모든 캐릭터는 18세 이상
title_i18n.pl: Zostałeś zapisany do szkoły dla elementali!!(1M?? Cholera!!) wszystkie postacie mają 18+
title_i18n.pt: Você foi matriculado em uma escola para elementais!!(1M?? Caralho!!) todos os personagens são maiores de 18 anos

title_i18n.tr: Elementaller için bir okula kaydolmuşsun!!(1M?? Aman Tanrım!!) tüm karakterler 18+
title_i18n.zh: 你已被录取到一所元素学校！！（1M?? 天哪！！）所有角色均为18+
